verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that an official Groq MCP server is documented at console.groq.com/docs/mcp, so the product ships its own capability for this story. Nothing in the pack describes what that server exposes, how an agent connects to it, or its auth and setup. The remote-MCP docs describe Groq acting as an MCP client that consumes external servers, which does not count toward this server story. missing for 10: details of the MCP server's tools and capabilities, connection/setup and auth documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting to it.
